title: Personal Loans Refinance Loans: Application Terms and the Borrower's Refinance Application
content:
## Terms

An existing borrower may replace an active Larkspur Personal Loans loan with a Larkspur refinance loan whose proceeds pay the old loan off. The refinance application is the borrower's own consent and is submitted by the borrower personally; it names the loan being refinanced, is prequalified at that loan's grade, carries the state of residence on the borrower's profile and the term the borrower chooses from the grade's available terms, and requests the amount financed that the refinance sizing of Personal Loans works out.

## When the amount is fixed

The amount financed on a refinance application is fixed only after the loan being refinanced carries a refinance-purpose payoff quote dated on the application date.

| The loan being refinanced, on the application date | The amount financed |
|---|---|
| carries a refinance-purpose payoff quote dated that day | can be fixed |
| carries no refinance-purpose payoff quote dated that day | is not yet fixed |

A refinance-purpose quote dated on an earlier day does not meet this; nor does a quote of another purpose dated that day.

## The refinance application tool

**What it does.** `submit_refinance_application_9ec5cb64` lets the borrower, by submitting it, consent to the refinance. It records one new personal loan application in applied status with the loan purpose refinance of an existing loan, dated today, naming the loan it will pay off, the prequalification grade, the state of residence, the term and the amount financed requested. The existing loan is not changed. Once recorded, the borrower sees the new application among their loans, in applied status, awaiting the underwriting decision.

**How it is invoked.** It is the borrower's own tool: the agent unlocks `submit_refinance_application_9ec5cb64` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it with the parameters below.

**Parameters.**

- `customer_id` - reference number of the applying borrower, as returned by the customer profile lookup.
- `refinanced_from_loan_id` - reference number of the existing Larkspur loan the refinance will pay off, as returned by the loan lookup.
- `variant_name` - prequalification rate grade of the application, exactly one of `Personal Loan Grade A`, `Personal Loan Grade B`, `Personal Loan Grade C`, `Personal Loan Grade D`, `Personal Loan Grade E`, `Personal Loan Grade F`, `Personal Loan Grade G`.
- `origination_state` - two-letter code of the borrower's state of residence on the profile, exactly one of AL, AK, AZ, AR, CA, CO, CT, DE, DC, FL, GA, HI, ID, IL, IN, IA, KS, KY, LA, ME, MD, MA, MI, MN, MS, MO, MT, NE, NV, NH, NJ, NM, NY, NC, ND, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VT, VA, WA, WV, WI, WY.
- `term_months` - repayment term the borrower chooses for the new loan, a whole number of months written as an integer, one of 24, 36, 48, 60 or 72; no empty value.
- `amount_financed` - loan amount requested on the application in US dollars, origination fee included, a decimal number with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to the cent.

**Return.** A one-line confirmation of the form "Refinance application <new loan id> submitted on <YYYY-MM-DD>: status applied, pays off loan <existing loan id>, <grade>, <state>, <term> months, amount financed <USD with 2 decimals>." The new loan id is the reference number of the application; the status applied means it was recorded.

The application is recorded in every case that reaches sizing; a loan with no unpaid principal is not quoted and so is never sized.
